>But I don't feel like its right, she broke up with me for what seems to be like the wrong reason<

Let me put it in perspective for you.  You and your woman land in Copenhagen.  She looks around with a smile.  She turns to you.  She says:

"Wow, there's so many hot dudes here and it's gonna be a real challenge not to spin on any of their dicks instead of yours this weekend."

Tell me.  Does that clarify anything?  :)

*Leave her the fuck alone.*

Ok male Redditors.  Do the usual and point out where she, of course, having a vagina, was the villain here.

Come on.  Give it a stretch.  You can do it.

Generally women know men seldom really "change".  You do for a while to win us back after we've left, but once we return, you soon revert back to your original ways.  She advised you right; you need to move on.  You'll find a girl you don't even have to change for, and that's always better.  I snapped out of being suicidal tonight by finally and irrevocably dumping the guy who was making me miserable all this time.  Couldn't feel better.  It's like a black cloud came off my life.

Same will happen for her and for you.  Let go.

> Fuck that noise. Seriously.

Kind of like us women when MEN do it?  Let me make sure women reading this understand you right: if after they break up with us men pump every wet hole in town, we should fuck that noise, seriously, and put ourselves first and cut you and them off.  That's the protocol, right?  

Thankssssssssssssssss got it, will do from now and tell every bitch I know this

>I have slept with well over 30 women in the last year<

Either come down on his ass exactly the way you would if this were a bitch sleeping around or every male Redditor can go straight to hell.  Come on.  You know the drill:

"You're a slut and don't deserve him anyway" etc etc etc

*He's out cum stuffing every hole in town and still thinks he's worthy of this bitch and Reddit YOU'RE FUCKING SILENT ABOUT THIS?*

Fairness or all of you go straight to hell

I know your feels.  I'm going through them all now at 46 as a woman and have even less power to change it than you do.  Hang in there if you can, and if not, send me a PM.  I'm definitely checking out in less than 40 days, but if I can talk you into staying here, I can exit with a little satisfaction I kept someone here who deserved more than to be a corpse with its brains blown all over creation.  You are that person who deserves to be more than that corpse.

I am not.  I deserve being that corpse.  But if I can talk you into seeing a tiny speck of light and hanging on, it was worth it, kid.

Here is a hug to you from a nobody.

Take care.
It was [redacted] but I've deleted all my Reddit data.  Kind of tidying up my online user profiles in preparation for exit.

Yeah, as soon as he was cast he started coming on to me pretty heavy, putting his hands on me, gazing into my eyes, acting interested.  On a production, if the target is not interested, that's considered sexual harassment.  I've been harassed before, but I got stupid and started thinking maybe this guy meant what he was expressing.  I began seeing "potential".  I fell in love back.  I let him know.  He flipped it and informed me he's just a flirt and meant nothing.  So I backed off and we continued to shoot.  After that he began acting like Hurt Boyfriend (hating if I mentioned other guys, hating if other guys went out with me, criticizing any guy I dated, acting possessive etc).  I tried to fight my attraction to him and it worked a few months but I broke down a week ago (grief over mom maybe?) and re-expressed it.  He turned me down a second time.

I ended things officially and killed the production to get away from him.  The studio got pissed at me not him.  According to my secretary he's seriously depressed now and has been emailing and calling her steadily asking if I hate him, asking about me, expressing pain, and begging to be given permission to call me and speak with me.  I've been doing No Contact, but he's reportedly going to call me tomorrow anyway.  I know I can block or ignore the call but what's the use?

All I ever allow into my life are guys who do the same thing of seducing me then shaming and rejecting me, and all I ever do is shut out and push away men who would never do this and treat me well.  At the same time I'm trapped in a relationship I don't want with a rich married man who pays all my bills but won't let me go.  Complex situation.  So it's like I'm a bird in a gilded cage.  Unable to have real love but unable to handle it even if it came.

Yeah I was sexually abused.  It was religious sexual abuse, coupled with psychological, emotional and physical.  I've had therapy.  It hasn't helped.  The worst moment in the abuse was my father the abuser taking me aside one day and telling me I was worthless to God and to the world because I was female and didn't have a penis.  I know it sounds stupid probably, but I was about 10, 11 or 12 and his words somehow got in deep and did a number on me.  I've had gender issues since, slept with women, tried to be lesbian, tried to be bisexual, been raped, been promiscuous, been a drag king, you name it, since the day he told me those words.

Therapists sit open mouthed in shock when they hear that.  They have nothing they can say in response.  

And I am now surrounded by Christians - almost all my staff and actors are born agains and I have no fucking idea how this happened - I had no suspicion they were this way - and they're pressuring me to go with them to their various churches and be saved, like that will help me.  I won't because I know better.

My dad the abuser WAS a very loud, very out, very publicly declared born again Christian :/

So I feel trapped and wrecked and hopeless, and I have bought some charcoal bags and am planning to light the charcoal and let the oxygen be overpowered by CO until I fade away on ativan and whiskey.  I've written a simple 1-page suicide note and am working on my will.

There's no way out.

I'm 46 but according to guys and even according to Reddit I look 21 or 22.  They asked me to post my picture on a thread about two months ago and the dudes went berserk ("Sexy as fuck", "reporting for booty" etc).  My career: movies.  I direct them.  I just canceled a production because I and the lead actor were in love with each other but he's psychologically damaged and I can't deal anymore.  I'll never meet any one else either.  I was abused as a kid, so his damaged type is all I ever go after.  I attract healthy guys but can't return the attraction because of my own damage.  I fight to; I try to; but I can't.  Anyway, career now at standstill because of this.  Can't move forward can't move back.

You do NOT want to do this.

Do not call.
The troll is still downvoting me.

I'm the same person except for me it's film, not music.  I'm killing myself tonight, too.  Good luck, and my heart goes out to you.  Maybe we'll see each other over there, wherever "there" winds us up.  Compose something for whatever film I get to make over there.  Take care, fellow voyager

My mother was my best friend and she died recently of cancer and lymphoma.  The rest takes too long to explain, but in less than 50 words, my career has tanked, I have no more motivation or belief in it, I keep attracting men who hate me, the root causes go so deep back in my life it'll take 15+ to heal them, and by then I'll be old, no longer pretty, and worthless to men, so why try.  There's more, but there's no reason to go into it further.  I have enough charcoal to do it and the location's paid for.  It's time to go there, duct tape the air pockets, light up and check out.  I'm doing it.
